description: Real WM-811K wafer with no defect pattern, paired with a real SECOM PASSING lot's sensor vector (class medoid, row 500).

sensor_provenance.selection: class medoid — the most typical row of its class, not the most extreme. The loudest failing row peaks at 21.8 sigma and would flatter the detector.

pairing: CONSTRUCTED. The wafer map and the sensor vector are both real measurements, but from different datasets and different wafers. No causal claim survives the join.
